{{Quote|A Star Destroyer! General Nossor Ri bought us a window… but the First Order will be on us in seconds! We must hit the hyperdrive now…|Aftab Ackbar during the mission to Mon Cala|<ref name="Allegiance 4" />}}
The '''MC95 Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] present in the [[the galaxy]] by the [[time]] following the [[Battle of Crait]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] in [[34 ABY]]. In [[35 ABY]], several were [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]s were in service to the [[Mon Calamari monarchy]], and several others formed part of the [[Resistance navy|naval forces]] of the [[Resistance]].

Many MC95 Star Cruisers participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] that saw the final destruction of the [[Sith]] and defeat of the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]]. The MC95 Star Cruiser gave rise to other sub-models, including the [[MC95A Star Cruiser|MC95A]], [[MC95B]], [[MC95C Star Cruiser|MC95C]], [[MC95D Star Cruiser|MC95D]], and [[MC95E Star Cruiser|MC95E]] models.

==Description==
The MC95 Star Cruiser was a class of [[Star Cruiser]] of [[Mon Calamari]] design.<ref name="Ship ST" /> Following the success of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] and the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]], the Mon Calamari manufactured the MC95 and created at least five sub-variants, the [[MC95A Star Cruiser|MC95A]], the [[MC95B]], the [[MC95C Star Cruiser|MC95C]], the [[MC95D Star Cruiser|MC95D]], and the [[MC95E Star Cruiser|MC95E]].<ref name="Ships FOR">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}}</ref> The MC95 was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] which gave it the capability of entering [[hyperspace]] at [[lightspeed]], and was equipped with [[engine]]s.<ref name="ROTR" /> The MC95 Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> had a [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]],<ref name="Allegiance 4" /> as well as two [[hangar]]s.<ref name="ROTR" /> Characteristic of other Mon Calamari ship designs,<ref name="A Final Alliance">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Target Exclusive)|featurette=A Final Alliance}}</ref> the MC95 Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> had a bulbous [[hull]] with differing modules. It could be disabled when struck by powerful [[Force lightning]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Role==
[[File:Resistance_fleet_ROTR.png|thumb|right|250px|An MC95 Star Cruiser during the Battle of Batuu.]]
As a [[capital ship]], the MC95 Star Cruiser had the ability to participate in [[Space warfare|naval warfare]],<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> and could serve in the capacity of a [[flagship]].<ref name="Allegiance 4" /> As a cruiser of this gigantic size, the MC95 could easily rival with some [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]] in combat, and would likely have been equipped with very powerful [[Deflector shield|shields]] like most [[MC-series star cruiser]]s.<ref name="ROTR" />

==History==
During the [[Resistance]]'s [[mission to Mon Cala]] after the [[Battle of Crait]], the [[Mon Calamari monarchy]] allied with the Resistance and dispatched [[Aftab Ackbar]] and [[Aftab Ackbar's MC95 Star Cruiser|his starship]] along with several other [[Nebulon-C escort frigate]]s, [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|MG-100 StarFortress SF-17s]], and [[starfighter]]s to escape with the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' just as the First Order arrived.<ref name="Allegiance 4" /> Later, two such starships were part of an [[Battle of Batuu|attack]] on the ''[[Finalizer]]'' and two other [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]] over [[Batuu]] as part of a strike [[fleet]].<ref name="ROTR" /> Several MC95 Star Cruisers participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]]<ref name="Ship ST" /> in [[35 ABY]] between the Resistance and the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The MC95 Star Cruiser first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' comic book [[Allegiance 4|''Allegiance'' 4]] in [[2019]],<ref name="Allegiance 4" /> and was developed for [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] according to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] [[Leland Chee]].<ref name="Leland">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1289391829373181952|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=Hynestian came from Production. MC95 was invented for Galaxy's Edge.|archivefile=File:Hynestian MC95.png|archivedate=20200801155345}}</ref> It was first identified in an installment of ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' on [[StarWarsKids.com]].<ref name="Ship ST" /> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] later confirmed that one of the MC95 Star Cruisers in Galaxy's Edge was named the ''Ardency'', which was made official on [[May 24]], [[2018]],<ref name="Pablo 1">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1454252664993181696|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Looking through my emails. The Ardency, the MC95 from Rise of Resistance came first and was christened on May 24, 2018.|archivedate=20211030185310}}</ref> and was previously known as the "Alcatraz Pickle Ship" before receiving its official name.<ref name="Pablo 2">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1454253168947171328|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=(Before that it was named Alcatraz Pickle Ship)|archivedate=20211030010555}}</ref>

The ''Ardency'' was created for ''[[Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance]]'', an amusement ride in ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge that first opened in [[December 5]], 2019.<ref name="DP">{{DPB|url=2019/12/disneyparkslive-watch-the-dedication-of-rise-of-the-resistance-live-on-dec-4|text=#DisneyParksLIVE: Watch the Dedication of Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance}}</ref> [[Phil Szostak]] began identifying ships to use in ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' in [[August]] of 2018, several months after the model was made for Galaxy's Edge, although he clarified that [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s work may have begun sooner.<ref name="Phil">{{Twitter|PhilSzostak|status/1454297354534744073|[[Phil Szostak]]|quote=I was identifying potential ships for the final battle at Exegol as early as August of 2018. But ILM's work may have begun even earlier than that.|archivedate=20211030185818}}</ref>
